2609.17327.title: Vroom-Vroom at SHROOM-Visions: A Multi-Judge Committee for Detecting Hallucinated Spans in Vision-Language Outputs
2609.17327.paper_summary: This paper describes our submission to the SHROOM-Visions shared task on detecting and classifying hallucinated character spans in vision-language model outputs across four languages. We employ several fine-tuned vision-language models as independent annotators and combine their span predictions through character-level majority voting, and additionally explore activation probes. The approach ranks first in three of four languages and places on the podium in every language and metric. Our analysis indicates that disagreement among diverse models tracks disagreement among human annotators.
2609.17327.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了我們對SHROOM-Visions共享任務的提交，該任務旨在檢測和分類視覺-語言模型輸出中的幻覺字符範圍，涵蓋四種語言。<lb/>我們使用幾個經過微調的視覺-語言模型作為獨立的標註者，並通過字符級的多數投票來結合它們的範圍預測，並進一步探索激活探針。<lb/>這種方法在四種語言中的三種中排名第一，並在每種語言和指標上都名列前茅。<lb/>我們的分析表明，來自不同模型之間的分歧與人類標註者之間的分歧相符。
